issue_context.title: Broadlink integration broken in core-2021.7.0b0
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Switches created in yaml with Broadlink platform are not working anymore in core-2021.7.0b0 (same as in #52465)
Log indicates "ID not unique" for (unchanged !) entities that were perfectly working.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.7.0b0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.6.6

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Supervised

### Integration causing the issue

Broadlink

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/broadlink/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Logger: homeassistant.components.switch
Source: helpers/entity_platform.py:567
Integration: Switch (documentation, issues)
First occurred: 15:55:35 (5 occurrences)
Last logged: 15:55:35

Platform broadlink does not generate unique IDs. ID 34ea34f43d68 already exists - ignoring switch.rm_printer
```


### Additional information

Is the exact same problem as mentioned in #52465, but for me it is still NOT working ...
comments:
From what I can tell, looking at the latest code, this is happening because the **switch** entities are all being given a unique id which is the same as the parent device (it is just doing `self._attr_unique_id = self._device.unique_id`. This is the same as the unique id given to the **remote** entity, and causing a conflict.

The **sensor** entity (if your Broadlink has a temperature sensor) uses
`self._attr_unique_id = f"{self._device.unique_id}-{self._monitored_condition}"` concatenating the monitored condition, to make it unique to the entity.

Presumably the **switch** entities need to use the switch name in the same way.
Especially, my rf devices were broken starting from version 2021.7.0b0

review_comments:
This is breaking for existing users, can we migrate existing entities?

Additionally, the name cannot be used, as it user-changeable, does not viable for use in unique IDs.

I may be wrong but, looking at the BroadlinkRMSwitch class from before 2021.7b0, it doesn't look like it previously assigned unique ids for the entities, they were added in https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/52177 so this looks like it may only be a breaking change if you are on the beta.

Since these are YAML configured would it actually be better to remove the unique id (but that would still be a breaking change if you're on the beta)?
And, if we want unique ids for these, we could add a separate **unique_id** option for the switch (like the option for the **template** integration).

You are right about the *unique_id* added in #52177, however it looks like an error, from what I see in moving this line will put things back to how they were before:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/4abdeec36ddcf7d69c855df50bec375b4efc3bd6/homeassistant/components/broadlink/switch.py#L149
to below:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/4abdeec36ddcf7d69c855df50bec375b4efc3bd6/homeassistant/components/broadlink/switch.py#L217
Without any breaking changes for those who are not on dev

Yup, that indeed a regression issue, well spotted @thecode.
Will write up a quick PR to at least restore the previous functionality with the upcoming release today.
